rationale: C03 plausibly supplied a concrete institutional drafting template. Both orders move from a policy requiring uniform executive-branch administration to a five-person President's Committee whose chairman and vice-chairman are designated by the President and whose members serve at the President's pleasure. They then assign the Committee periodic review and recommendation functions and impose implementation and liaison duties on department and agency heads. C07 is a secondary structural analogue because it combines a President's Committee with an Advisory Council and uncompensated service, while C20 is substantively close in organizing a voluntary employee financial-participation program through a central committee and departmental implementation. Neither matches the child's core institutional sequence as closely as C03.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There is hereby established the President's Committee on Fund-Raising within the Federal Service... The Committee shall be composed of five persons... The President... shall designate the Chairman and Vice Chairman... [members] shall serve at the pleasure of the President.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: There is hereby established the President's Committee on Government Employment Policy... The Committee shall be composed of five members... The President shall designate the Chairman and the Vice-Chairman... each member... shall serve at the pleasure of the President.
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive near-verbatim committee-creation machinery, including the committee size, presidential designation of both officers, and pleasure-of-the-President tenure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Committee shall: (a) Periodically review the conduct and operation of the fund-raising program... (b) Recommend to the President such changes in policy as it believes necessary...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Committee shall: (a) Advise the President periodically as to whether... practices... are in conformity with the... policy... and... recommend methods of assuring uniformity in such practices.
shared_material.explanation: Both assign a presidential committee periodic oversight of compliance with a stated uniform policy and recommendations for improving its administration.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The head of each department or agency shall... [ensure compliance]... Cooperate with the Committee... [and] Designate a representative to work with the Committee...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The head of each executive department and agency shall be responsible for the effectuation of the policy... [and] shall designate an official of his department or agency as Employment Policy Officer.
shared_material.explanation: Parallel decentralized implementation machinery makes agency heads responsible and requires a designated agency-level official or representative to connect the department with the central committee.
